blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said on Thursday that electric Love bus operations would be suspended from Nov. 16 to Nov. 18, during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and related meetings. READ: MMDA gearing up for Asean Summit, deploying over 2,600 personnel Malacañang earlier declared the dates as special non-working days in Metro Manila to prevent traffic congestion. The move also aims to strengthen security ahead of the high-stakes regional meeting, which will bring together foreign leaders and delegations from the 11 member states and dialogue partners China, South Korea, Japan, United States, […]...
